title: Cell Type-Specific Gene Expression Analyses by RNA Sequencing Reveal Local High Nitrate-Triggered Lateral Root Initiation in Shoot-Borne Roots of Maize by Modulating Auxin-Related Cell Cycle Regulation
tissue: shoot-borne (crown) root stele 5-25 mm from tip (separated from cortex); LCM phloem-pole pericycle and endodermis cells (5-10 mm) used for gene-specific expression (e.g., PIN9)
stage_age: ~60 d after germination (treatment started when 7th whorl of shoot-borne roots emerged)
growth_system: hydroponic split-root; growth chamber (16 h 25 °C light / 8 h 21 °C dark)
N_treatments: homogeneous low nitrate 0.5 mM NO3- (control) vs local high nitrate 4 mM NO3- supplied to one split-root half (other half 0.5 mM); Ca(NO3)2
other_factors: none (NPA pretreatment 25 uM for 4 d used in some experiments)
timepoints_duration: RNA-seq timepoint unclear (page summary: 24 h after local high nitrate; abstract: changes within 12 h); qRT-PCR time courses 0-36 h
bio_reps: NR for RNA-seq (page summary mentions 4 reps of 20-24 roots; unconfirmed)
n_libraries: 8 ('eight libraries were pooled in one lane')
other_omics: IAA and conjugates (UPLC-ESI-MS/MS); DR5::RFP imaging; histology; LCM + qRT-PCR
key_finding: Local high nitrate up-regulated cell-cycle activators and PIN9-mediated auxin efflux in stele/pericycle, triggering lateral root initiation
source_of_details: abstract + publisher page (PMC HTML via WebFetch, truncated before data statement) + web search
notes: PubMed full-text tool returned no text; accession not found - web search surfaced SRA SRX1020537 ('Homogeneous low nitrate, control, biol. Repl.2, paired 1') and BioProject PRJNA283053 as UNVERIFIED candidates; RNA-seq was on stele tissue, not LCM cells, despite title; RNA-seq replicate number and sampling time need confirmation

title: Asymmetric transcriptomic signatures between the cob and florets in the maize ear under optimal- and low-nitrogen conditions at silking, and functional characterization of amino acid transporters ZmAAP4 and ZmVAAT3
tissue: ear cob (central tissue); peripheral florets (harvested separately)
stage_age: silking (newly emerging silks 1-5 cm; ~50% of plants silking); sampled 6-7 a.m.
growth_system: field, Shangzhuang Experimental Station, China Agricultural University, Beijing; 4 replicate plots per treatment; year NR
N_treatments: ON 250 kg N/ha vs LN 0 kg N/ha (N form NR)
other_factors: low P (no 135 kg P2O5/ha) and low K (no 120 kg K2O/ha) plots sampled for RT-qPCR only (to define LN-specific genes)
n_libraries: 12 (2 tissues x 2 N levels x 3 reps)
platform_layout: DGE 3'-tag profiling (NlaIII-anchored 21-nt tags), Illumina HiSeq 2000, 49 cycles single-read
other_omics: RT-qPCR; amino acid transporter assays (yeast, Arabidopsis); GFP localization
key_finding: LN altered 588 cob vs 195 floret genes; cob dominates ear LN response; ZmAAP4/ZmVAAT3 transport amino acids
notes: Paper states data deposited in GEO but the accession number is missing from the PMC text; web search repeatedly linked GSE59613 (OmicsDI) and BioProject PRJNA255755 (FAIDARE) to this paper - UNVERIFIED (PMC page fetch blocked by reCAPTCHA); 3'-tag (DGE) data, not full-length RNA-seq; >54 M high-quality reads in total

title: Controlled-release urea optimizes the pathway to yield increase via post-anthesis carbon-nitrogen coordination in maize
growth_system: field microplots (5 x 8 m; 75,000 plants/ha), Yuanyang Science and Education Park, Henan Agricultural University, Xinxiang, China; trials 2023-2024, RNA-seq samples from a single year (year NR)
N_treatments: all sequenced samples 180 kg N/ha: U (all urea; basal:jointing topdress 2:3) vs C1 (CRU-N:urea-N 1:2) vs C2 (2:1) vs C3 (all polyurethane-coated CRU-N); C1-C3 single basal application; field CK (0 N) not sequenced
timepoints_duration: single sampling at grain filling; seasons ~100 d (mid-June to late September)
other_omics: LC-MS/MS leaf metabolomics; C/N physiology; yield components; qRT-PCR
key_finding: CRU-urea blends upregulated amino acid and carbon metabolism genes (GLT1, IDH3) in ear leaves, raising yield
notes: BORDERLINE for the N criterion: identical N rate in all sequenced samples - contrast is urea vs controlled-release urea (release kinetics/application timing), not N level or chemical form; per-sample SRA accessions in Table S4; 38-54 M read pairs per sample

title: Identification and characterization of circRNAs in maize seedlings under deficient nitrogen
N_treatments: HN vs LN (concentrations and N form NR in abstract)
other_omics: DE miRNAs integrated (source NR); overlap with GWAS loci; qRT-PCR validation
key_finding: 24 leaf and 22 root DE circRNAs under LN; 34 predicted miRNA decoys in ceRNA networks
notes: No PMC full text; accession search not completed (web search budget exhausted); same Sichuan Agricultural University group as lncRNA study PMID 33579187 (BMC Plant Biol 2021; inbred P178; HN 4 mM vs LN 0.04 mM KNO3; 14-d hydroponic seedlings; leaf + root; 3 reps; 12 lncRNA-seq + 12 sRNA-seq libraries, HiSeq 2500) - circRNA data may derive from those libraries but this is NOT verified

title: Bioinoculant substitution enhances rhizosphere soil quality and maize growth by modulating microbial communities and host gene expression in alkaline soils
growth_system: pot experiment, nutrient-deficient alkaline calcareous soil (location NR)
N_treatments: full N vs half N (HN) vs zero N (ZN) (rates and form NR), with/without bioinoculant
other_factors: solid bioinoculant (Bacillus velezensis FZB42 + attapulgite clay)
other_omics: rhizosphere microbiome sequencing; soil quality indices; growth and yield; structural equation modelling
key_finding: Bioinoculant under reduced N upregulated nutrient transport and photosynthesis genes; best biomass at half N
notes: TENTATIVE inclusion: abstract does not state the RNA-seq method or which N x inoculant treatments were sequenced; no PMC text; could not verify (web search budget exhausted); check full text before download
